item.title: 'Unprecedented' agreement releases emergency oil reserves as gas prices spark concerns
item.summary: A group developed nations agreed to release a record amount of emergency oil reserves Wednesday in response to the effect the U.S. attacks against Iran have had on the oil market.

item.title: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink argues US-Iran conflict won't derail economy as gas prices surge
item.summary: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink predicts the U.S. war with Iran will not last long, and oil prices could fall below $50 per barrel once the conflict ends and Iran reenters global markets.

item.title: Rogan says voters feel 'betrayed' by Trump's Iran campaign after he pledged 'no more wars' for years
item.summary: The U.S. strikes on Iran contradict President Donald Trump's 2024 campaign pledge to avoid wars, podcast host Joe Rogan said Tuesday while discussing the conflict.

item.title: CNN reporter deletes post falsely calling Mamdani ‘target of political violence’ in latest foul-up
item.summary: A CNN reporter botched coverage of the New York City terrorist attack a third time for the network when calling Mayor Zohran Mamdani a "target of political violence."

item.title: Ax-wielding suspect subdued by teen military recruit's MMA takedown in car wash clash caught on video
item.summary: A Florida man allegedly threatened car wash workers with an ax before being taken down by a teen MMA-trained employee protecting his younger brother.

item.title: House Oversight Committee demands depositions from Bondi and Lutnick in Epstein probe
item.summary: The House Oversight Committee is moving to depose AG Pam Bondi and Secretary Howard Lutnick in a push to uncover the full extent of Jeffrey Epstein's network.

item.title: Bipartisan housing push advances, but Trump-backed investor ban faces resistance
item.summary: Some Senate Democrats and industry groups oppose an institutional investor ban in a housing bill, arguing the provision would eliminate build-to-rent units and reduce rentals.

item.title: Trump administration puts key Biden-era immigration policy on notice: 'Unsustainable cycle'
item.summary: The Trump administration is looking to undo temporary protected status designations for hundreds of thousands of migrants in the U.S., which would reverse a key Biden-era policy.

item.title: California State University board meeting falls into chaos amid SJSU lawsuit vs Trump admin over trans scandal
item.summary: CSU and San Jose State University sued the federal government over Title IX transgender volleyball findings after Education Secretary threatened funding cuts.

item.title: Trump predicts political future for boxer Jake Paul, offers 'complete and total endorsement' at Kentucky rally
item.summary: President Donald Trump introduced Jake Paul at a political rally in Hebron, Kentucky, on Wednesday, predicting the YouTuber turned boxer will one day seek political office.
